trial_court: Civil Judge (Senior Division), Patnagarh, MAT C.S. No. 49 of 2020
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed CMP for direction to Civil Judge (Senior Division) for early disposal of MAT C.S. No. 49 of 2020.

legal_principles.principle: The court should not grant unnecessary adjournments.
legal_principles.held: It is, however, observed that Civil Judge (Senior Division), Patnagarh should not grant unnecessary adjournment.

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider the mandate of Section 21-B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 while granting adjournments.
legal_principles.held: It is further submitted by learned counsel for the Petitioner that while granting adjournments, learned Civil Judge should have taken into consideration the mandate of Section 21-B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

outcome.final_order: Civil Judge (Senior Division), Patnagarh should not grant unnecessary adjournment; Petitioner can file application for early disposal within two weeks.

use_for_drafting: guiding principles for early disposal of matrimonial disputes
strategies for dealing with repeated adjournments in family courts
